name: accountIds
label: Accounts
help: Social accounts to post to. When mapping, provide an array of SimplePost account IDs, for example from **List accounts**.

nested.name: scheduledFor
nested.label: Scheduled for
nested.help: Date and time to publish the post. It must be in the future.

name: message
label: Message
help: Text of the post. Can be empty for media-only posts.

name: media
label: Media
help: Images or videos to attach to the post.

spec.name: url
spec.label: File URL
spec.help: Public URL of the image or video. SimplePost imports the file before publishing. To use a file from a previous module, upload it with **Upload a media file** and map the **File URL** from its output.

spec.name: filename
spec.label: File name
spec.help: File name with extension, for example `launch.png`.

spec.name: id
spec.label: Media ID
spec.help: Any value that identifies this file within the post, for example the file name. Map the **Media ID** from **Upload a media file** when you use it.

spec.name: size
spec.label: File size
spec.help: File size in bytes. Enter `0` if you don't know it. SimplePost measures the file when it imports it.

spec.name: contentType
spec.label: Content type
spec.help: MIME type of the file, for example `image/jpeg` or `video/mp4`. If left empty, SimplePost detects it.

spec.name: thumbnailUrl
spec.label: Thumbnail URL
spec.help: Optional cover image URL for a video.

name: thread
label: Thread
help: Additional posts published as replies after the main post, on platforms that support threads (X, Threads, Bluesky). Up to 24 items.

spec.name: media
spec.label: Media
spec.help: Images or videos for this thread post.

spec.name: url
spec.label: File URL
spec.help: Public URL of the image or video. SimplePost imports the file before publishing. To use a file from a previous module, upload it with **Upload a media file** and map the **File URL** from its output.

spec.name: filename
spec.label: File name
spec.help: File name with extension, for example `launch.png`.

spec.name: id
spec.label: Media ID
spec.help: Any value that identifies this file within the post, for example the file name. Map the **Media ID** from **Upload a media file** when you use it.

spec.name: size
spec.label: File size
spec.help: File size in bytes. Enter `0` if you don't know it. SimplePost measures the file when it imports it.

spec.name: contentType
spec.label: Content type
spec.help: MIME type of the file, for example `image/jpeg` or `video/mp4`. If left empty, SimplePost detects it.

spec.name: thumbnailUrl
spec.label: Thumbnail URL
spec.help: Optional cover image URL for a video.

name: repost
label: Repost
help: Reposts the post automatically after a delay, on platforms that support reposts. If left empty, your SimplePost repost defaults apply.

spec.name: delayHours
spec.label: Delay in hours
spec.help: Hours to wait after publishing. Maximum `720` (30 days).

name: accountOptions
label: Platform settings
help: Platform-specific settings keyed by account ID, as JSON. For example `{"<account ID>": {"title": "Launch video", "privacyStatus": "public"}}` for YouTube. For the available settings, see the [SimplePost API reference](https://docs.simplepost.social/api-reference).

name: accountOverrides
label: Account overrides
help: Different content for specific accounts, keyed by account ID, as JSON. Each value can contain `message`, `media`, and `thread`. For example `{"<account ID>": {"message": "Shorter text for X"}}`.

name: imageFit
label: Image fitting
help: Fits images that don't meet a platform's size or aspect-ratio rules. **Blur background** keeps the full image over a blurred background. **Crop** trims the edges. If left empty, images are published unchanged and validation reports any incompatibility. Requires image fitting to be enabled for your SimplePost account.

name: quotePostId
label: Quoted post ID
help: ID of an existing SimplePost post to quote, on platforms that support quote posts.

name: idempotencyKey
label: Idempotency key
help: A unique value, for example a record ID from a previous module. If a request with the same key is repeated, SimplePost returns the original post instead of creating a duplicate.
